title: Magazine p. 42: Gemini-4 photo of Titan booster in orbit (NASA S-65-35452)
description: Photocopied magazine page dominated by a grainy, high-contrast photograph (numbered 6) of scattered light specks, captioned "Gemini-4 photo of 30-foot long Titan booster rocket nearby in orbit; Fuzziness (a familiar space photo effect) is due to magnification. McDivitt later saw the booster again but failed to recognize it, giving rise to the most impressive UFO case in history. NASA S-65-35452." The article text below discusses the incomplete NORAD list, McDivitt's eye irritation during the flight, and NICAP's handling of the photo.
